## Evidence and updates
Officially confirmed sources take precedence. Third-party reports and community bug discussions are labeled and not represented as independently verified. Rockstar has not announced a GTA VI Online launch date, crossplay or PC release. We do not promise universal fixes.
Official announcements: https://www.rockstargames.com/newswire/
Official support: https://support.rockstargames.com/VI
